title: i18n(service-settings): ship the built-in settings pages in ru, de and ko
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D7v5H7BaFmL7sUCoN7tSxhm)_

domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cya5ej5GQV86RPbRPK

Part of #30512 — package 6 of 11, second half (`@objectstack/service-settings` in `ru`, `de`, `ko`; the first half, `zh-Hant`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, landed in #30870). With it every built-in settings page carries all eleven platform languages. The card stays open: platform-objects follows, and the last PR of the series makes the bundle check read the platform locale table.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 「设置」里内置的设置页（邮件、短信、品牌、公司、本地化、认证、文件存储、AI 与向量、知识库，以及 `@objectstack/objectql` 注册的数据生命周期页）的页标题和说明、分组、字段名和帮助、选项、提示条、操作按钮和来源标记，补上俄语、德语、韩语 3 种。繁中、阿语、法语、巴葡已在上半包（#30870）落地，至此本包 11 种语言齐全。
- **为什么改：** 平台语言表要求每个界面带齐 11 种语言；这是第 3 期按包补齐的第 6 个包的下半。用这 3 种语言的管理员打开「设置」不再看到英文。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加 3 个翻译文件和注册行，不动逻辑、schema、接口；原有 8 种语言一字未改。交接提交里改 `localization-currency-lock` / `localization-locale-options` 文案表的部分**按席位裁决整段去掉**：#30630（已作为 #30734 落地）拥有这两张表，且已带齐 11 种语言。测试改动只是覆盖测试把 3 种新语言加进列表（覆盖变宽，没有放宽断言）。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `src/translations/index.ts`（按表标签注册，排在上半包 4 种之后），再看 `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts`，然后抽看任一新语言文件。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run src/translations/settings-translation-coverage.test.ts` 全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- Three new hand-authored translation modules under the platform locale table's tags (`ru`, `de`, `ko`), covering every built-in settings manifest: page titles and descriptions, group headings, field labels and help, option labels, banners, action buttons and the source badges. Country pickers name each country in the reader's language through `Intl.DisplayNames`, as the existing locales do.
- `src/translations/index.ts` registers them in `settingsBuiltinTranslations` after the first half's four and exports them beside the existing eight.
- Carried from the released handover commit `bc852648` (session `session_01Utp6Cai5CRdAs4u9gTipWU`) **without** its `localization-currency-lock.ts` / `localization-locale-options.ts` hunks, per the seat's ruling of 2026-11-05: #30630, landed as #30734, owns those copy tables and already carries all eleven languages there. This PR does not touch them.

## Tests

- `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts` holds the three new locales to the same full coverage of every built-in manifest. No assertion changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Quality bar (#17508 / PR #19345):** every leaf written for the reader; placeholders, code spans, URLs and identifiers byte-identical, checked mechanically per leaf against `en` and against `zh-CN` (which carries the inline-manifest keys `en.ts` does not): key set, `{{holes}}`, `{holes}`, backtick spans, angle tokens, all three locales zero diffs. Russian and Korean keep identifiers, hosts and URLs in Latin script.
- **Leaves equal to English, on purpose:** provider, product and protocol names (`SMTP`, `S3`, `OpenAI`, `Anthropic`, `Vercel AI Gateway`, `Turso / libSQL`, `RAGFlow`, …) and the terms the existing `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` / `es-ES` also leave in English (`Base URL`, `Embedder`), in all three; in `de` also words German uses as they are (`Host`, `Port`, `Branding`, `Website`, `Region`, `Backend`, `Adapter`, `Bucket`, `Global`) and the country names `Intl.DisplayNames` spells the same in German (`Andorra`, `Afghanistan`, …).
- No cross-locale coincidence: `check:i18n-stale-fill` passes with the baseline untouched.
- No string opens with `os ` followed by a lowercase word (`check-cli-command-ids` passes), and the whole "Lint · docs & code guards" lane was run locally before opening.
